item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's mother mixes wheat flour with yeast, sugar and warm water to make dough. After one hour the dough rises and becomes larger in size. She makes a second dough in the same way but without yeast, and it does not rise in the same way.
Why does the dough with yeast rise?

options.A: Yeast is a microorganism that grows in the warm dough and makes the dough rise after some time.
options.B: Warm water and flour rise on their own, so the yeast is not needed at all.
options.C: Yeast is only a flavouring powder and the sugar alone makes the dough rise.
options.D: The dough rises first, which then gives the yeast enough room to grow in it.
